question: What does FM's own visible-attribute builder return for every display attribute of every managed first-team player, with no player screen open?
limitations: Scope is the managed first team; the manager has full knowledge there, so no attribute is expected to come back as range or unknown in practice.
This calls the same proven, ui-verified builder used by the one-call-at-a-time cold-visibility tool, in-process, for every player and attribute in one session.
Broader population is a discoverability question, not a Frida limitation, and is out of scope for this recipe.
